tagline: Your Campus Is Bigger Than Your Campus
design_archetype: Electric Indigo & Modern Slate (High-energy, crisp typography, youthful professional hybrid aesthetic)

typography.font_family_heading: Plus Jakarta Sans, Clash Display, sans-serif

hierarchy.hero_heading: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

layout_and_structure.desktop_shell: 3-column responsive grid (Sidebar Navigation + Main Content Feed/Hub + Contextual Right Panel)
layout_and_structure.mobile_shell: Sticky glass header + scrollable body + Fixed Bottom Navigation Bar (5 core tabs)

key_features_visual_design.landing_page: High-impact Hero section with mesh glow gradient, video discovery teaser, live stats ticker, student testaments grid, and interactive CTA.
key_features_visual_design.student_feed: Infinite scroll cards, story ribbon at top, post creation widget with media attachments/polls, like/comment/share/bookmark counters, filter pill tabs.
key_features_visual_design.stories: Instagram/Snapchat style 24h stories top bar with avatar aura glows, fullscreen modal viewer with progress bars, reactions, and viewer list.
key_features_visual_design.student_discovery: Search header with filters (College, Major, Graduation Year, Skills, Open for Collaboration), grid of student profiles with reputation badges & endorsement stats.
key_features_visual_design.meet_someone_random_video: Split screen or PIP video view, interactive interest chips selection, instant 'Skip / Next' match button, WebRTC stream indicator, and solo test interactive partner bot simulator.
key_features_visual_design.webrtc_video_calling: Floating or full-screen call room with local/remote video grids, mic/camera/screen-share controls, in-call overlay chat drawer, signal state badge.
key_features_visual_design.realtime_messaging: Split view chat hub, recent chats list with unread badges & online status dot, active message window with typing indicators, media preview.
key_features_visual_design.project_collaboration: Project cards with needed roles, skill tags, team rosters, applicant tracking modal, apply modal with AI bio match suggestion.
key_features_visual_design.meeting_scheduler: Calendly-style availability selector, interactive slot booking modal, scheduled meetings list with Google Calendar/ICS export simulation.
key_features_visual_design.college_communities: Hub page for Stanford, MIT, Oxford, LPU, Berkeley with student rosters, community posts, follower counts, and event announcements.
key_features_visual_design.reputation_system: Peer endorsement breakdown (Technical Skill, Leadership, Collaboration, Reliability), overall score radial meter, endorse modal.
key_features_visual_design.admin_dashboard: Metrics cards (Active users, matches made, reports pending), moderation table with action buttons (Warn, Suspend, Ban), system analytics charts.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: MANDATORY. Every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, dropdowns, modal triggers, video control icons) must have a semantic kebab-case data-testid attribute.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: Text contrast must satisfy WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text). Dark backgrounds (#080B11, #0F1623) paired with bright slate/white text (#F8FAFC, #94A3B8) and electric indigo highlights.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all features mentioned in key_functionalities are completely built and functional with backend API integration and seed data.
Implement WebRTC peer connection logic with automatic simulated mock video partner bot when testing solo or when peer signaling is pending.
Include the AI-assisted Project Match & Bio Enhancer button in the profile edit modal and project join application modal.
Make sure every tab/page loads cleanly without horizontal scroll glitches, with responsive bottom nav for mobile screens.
Use Lucide icons consistently across the application.
Deliver rich seed data containing 8+ students across Stanford, MIT, Oxford, LPU, Berkeley with realistic stories, projects, posts, comments, and booking slots.
